messages:
rachel: Quick note 1: we saw a small spike (~1.9%) of leads without owners when enrichment callbacks lagged. RR was timing out early.

ben: timeline? was this HubSpot-only?

rachel: both HS and SF, but HS calls /assign before enrichment sometimes. Callback latency hit ~50s window. RR wrote owner=null.

omar: short fix: add a 25s handshake wait and mark lead as `pending_assign` instead of owner=null. After handshake expiry route to `sdr-fallback`.

ben: config snippet:
```
routing:
  handshake_seconds: 25
  pending_flag: true
  fallback_pool: "sdr-fallback"
  retry_jitter_ms: 1200
```

rachel: also add lead property `routing_note=handshake_canary` for SDR visibility and `owner_history` for audits.

omar: obs: emit metrics `routing.handshake.wait_ms`, `routing.fallback.count`, and alert if unassigned_rate > 1% over 15m.

ben: SalesOps wants a canary email and CSV export of fallback leads. I'll draft the note.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4399: "Handshake gate canary + SalesOps export" assigned to growth-eng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4399 :white_check_mark:

rachel: plan: 5% canary, monitor 30m, expand to 25% if stable. QA will simulate delayed callbacks and duplicate events. I'll PR HS workflow gate to only POST /assign when `enrichment_status=complete` or handshake expires.

ben: rollback: flip feature flag off and revert handshake_seconds to 0, notify SalesOps.

rachel: will ping here when PRs + canary kickoff are live.
